[[General/Legends|General]] '''Harrid Sendo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. He was a non-combat officer in the [[Destabilization|Destab Branch]] of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. He had a double life as a Black Sun agent.

==History==
Sendo served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]]. He never saw action on the field, but through years of patient service (and covering his tracks), managed to reach the nominal rank of General. As a high ranked review specialist, he had access to all kinds of Intelliegence  information from where he worked.<ref name="sb" />

After years of loyalty to the Empire, but especially after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] he was not sure that his institution would last forever.<ref name="sb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

He was approached by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], tasked with providing [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] with developments from Intelligence; this made him one of the hundreds of informants out from the Imperial machine, although Sendo was unaware of that, and vainly considered himself an essential part of the Black Sun network. Sendo trasferred his reports to various Black Sun [[courier/Legends|couriers]]. Sometimes, aided by disguise and Xizor's [[agent/Legends|agents]], he met the [[Dark Prince]] personally to deliver more important information. Occassionally he had to get rid of data that would incriminate or hinder Black Sun operations.<ref name="sb" />

Each month Xizor would give him a 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] notes in a [[Plastex/Legends|plastex]] envelope for his services and reaffirming his loyalty. Through covert channels, this money was directed towards a luxurious island villa on [[Avenelle]], where Sendo planned his retirement.<ref name="sb" />

One day he met Xizor in his audience chamber, informing him about the [[occupation of Bespin]], during which [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] left behind a [[garrison/Legends|garrison]]; he mentioned [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|his failure]] to capture [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] and the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had recalled him back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He didn't know that the Dark Prince knew all these from his other informants.<ref>{{WEGCite|story=Up the Intelligence Ladder|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>
